messages:
poppy: finally swapped to a hammock desk today. immediate verdict: 10/10 for vibes, 0/10 for camera stability. pic attached 📸
arman: pics pls :eyes:
poppy: uploading... (2 pics) — hammock with laptop across my lap, moose (dog) curled up judging me 
shea: pro tip: clip-on webcam mount on top of a fixed pole or shelf. stops the swinging cam effect
evan: or mount the camera to a bookshelf and frame it on a stable surface so the hammock motion doesn't show
poppy: also learned that typing in a hammock makes my wrists do yoga. question: should i (1) clamp a tray to the hammock, (2) get a small fold-out table inside the hammock, (3) move back to the chair? vote 1️⃣ 2️⃣ 3️⃣
arman: 1️⃣ for aesthetics + coziness
shea: 3️⃣ for reliability during calls unless you have a gimbal for your webcam :joy:
roo: 2️⃣ compromise — small table for coffee + laptop tray for posture
netbot: [automated] On 2423456795 detected brief packet jitter (~180ms) on AP 'HammockMesh' coinciding with 2423456793-2423456797 camera upload. No sustained outages.
poppy: ah that explains the odd lag in my last call. lowering camera resolution for meetings should help
evan: also consider a bluetooth headset for audio if the camera keeps swinging
poppy: follow-up poll: if i keep the hammock, should i get (1) camera arm, (2) bluetooth headset, (3) dedicated laptop tray? vote 1️⃣ 2️⃣ 3️⃣
arman: 2️⃣ - audio wins over video when you're mobile
shea: 1️⃣ - camera arm is very chef's kiss for the aesthetic board
roo: 3️⃣ for posture long-term
poppy: thanks all! i'll grab a clip arm and try a lower-res stream for the week. will report if Moose becomes the new CCO (Chief Comfort Officer) 😂
netbot: [reminder] Safety tip: secure power bricks and avoid sudden tugs on cables when in swinging furniture. See KB: http://tiny.cc/hammock-wfh
arman: also proposing a new badge: 'Hammock Hustle' for the aesthetics board :tshirt:
shea: vote for 'Moose Cameo' as mandatory meeting guest :camera_with_flash:
